description: Multi-column text flow with a readable measure, vertical rhythm (between direct children), column rules and break hygiene. Attribute form: data-layout="columns" (same modifiers), usually on an <article data-prose>. <reader-view> needs the element form.

attributes.name: data-layout-align
attributes.description: justify: justified text with automatic hyphenation. Justified narrow columns form uneven word gaps (WCAG 1.4.8, AAA): prefer ragged-right for long text.

attributes.name: data-layout-column-count
attributes.description: Number of columns. 2 and 3 are maximums: below about 14rem per column they drop to fewer columns (one on a phone). auto fits as many --column-min-width (38ch) columns as the element's own width allows.

attributes.name: data-layout-measure
attributes.description: Line measure (--measure-narrow / --measure-normal / --measure-wide). Count 1 caps the block width. Counts 2 and 3 cap each column, so the block is at most count × measure + gaps (without the attribute they fill the container). auto uses the measure as the column width.

attributes.name: data-layout-max
attributes.description: Same as data-layout-measure (ch-based, unlike layout-center's rem-based data-layout-max).

attributes.name: data-layout-centered
attributes.description: No effect: columns are always centered (margin-inline: auto). Read by the shared typographic core.

childAttributes.name: data-bleed
childAttributes.description: Break out to the full inline size of the nearest query container (main, article, section). Spans every column in a multi-column flow.
